title: Ops Hardening
description: Database/JWT credentials moved to Kubernetes Secrets; order-matcher journal rotates at snapshot boundaries and archives closed segments to GCS; the shared build pipeline always rebuilds a fresh jar before the Docker build.

nodes.label: mariadb-credentials (Secret)
nodes.description: Created out-of-band via kubectl; never committed. Referenced by secretKeyRef from database, order-matcher, trade-processor, account-service, position-service.

nodes.label: auth-secrets (Secret)
nodes.description: Created out-of-band via kubectl; never committed. Referenced by secretKeyRef from order-matcher, trade-processor for AUTH_JWT_SECRET/AUTH_DEV_TOKEN_MASTER_SECRET.

nodes.label: database (MariaDB)
nodes.description: Existing MariaDB Deployment; credentials now sourced from mariadb-credentials instead of literal manifest values.

nodes.label: order-matcher (BLP + risk gateway)
nodes.description: Existing BLP; DB/JWT creds now from Secrets. Journaler rotates at each snapshot boundary when journal.archive.enabled.

nodes.label: JournalArchiver
nodes.description: New: background-thread uploader inside order-matcher. Uploads closed journal segments to GCS via an HMAC-authenticated S3 client.

nodes.label: order-matcher-journal-gcs-hmac (Secret, optional)
nodes.description: Created out-of-band via kubectl; never committed. Its absence disables only the GCS upload leg, not pod startup or rotation.

nodes.label: GCS: order-matcher-journal-archive
nodes.description: Destination for closed journal segments, uploaded via GCS's S3-compatible XML API.

nodes.label: trade-processor
nodes.description: Existing service; DB/JWT/dev-token creds now from Secrets.

nodes.label: publish-generated-state-branch.sh
nodes.description: Shared build pipeline script; now runs gradlew clean bootJar before docker build for any JVM service context.

edges.label: hands off closed segment at snapshot boundary
gradlew bootJar before docker build (build-time only)
